info.amfiName: Aditya Birla Sun Life Nifty India Defence Index Fund
info.cat: Open Ended Schemes(Index Funds - Equity Funds)
info.objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to provide returns that, before expenses, correspond to the total returns of securities as represented by the Nifty India Defence Total Return Index, subject to tracking errors. The Scheme does not guarantee/indicate any returns. There is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
info.benchmark: Nifty India Defence Total Return Index
exitLoad: For redemption / switch-out of units on or before 30 days from the date of allotment: 0.05% of applicable NAV.
For redemption / switch-out of units after 30 days from the date of allotment: Nil.

alloc.label: Equity and Equity related securities constituting the Nifty India Defence Index

extra.type: An open ended Index Fund replicating the Nifty India Defence Total Return Index
